confidence.rationale: The official site and restaurant-linked Toast catalog establish identity and expose substantially more current scope than Luna recorded, but their differing menus and no restaurant-issued allergen matrix prevent a complete allergen or cross-contact conclusion.

identity.scope: Bammy's Modern Caribbean, 301 Water St. SE Suite 115, Washington, DC 20003.
identity.notes: Restaurant-controlled homepage links Toast ordering; Toast repeats the restaurant name and exact address.

sources.title: Bammy's Modern Caribbean homepage
sources.excerpt: Restaurant-controlled homepage identifies BAMMY'S and links both its menu and Toast ordering.

sources.title: Bammy's official menu
sources.excerpt: HTML menu lists appetizers, entrees, seafood, sides, cocktails, beer, wines, frozen drinks, brunch, and brunch sides. It contains a raw/undercooked-food warning, not an allergen matrix or cross-contact statement.

sources.title: Bammy's Toast ordering catalog
sources.excerpt: Toast identifies Bammy's at 301 Water St. SE Suite 115 and enumerates Food Items, Catering, Spirit's, and Specials; food sections include lunch, appetizers, entrees, seafood, pasta and fried rice, sides, dessert, and condiments.

sources.title: Targeted allergen-source search
sources.excerpt: Targeted search returned the restaurant menu but no Bammy's restaurant-issued allergen matrix, ingredient document, or cross-contact policy.

sources.title: eatbammys.com search-discovered site
sources.excerpt: Search results describe a Bammy's Washington DC site, but direct retrieval returned no inspectable menu content; it was not used to establish menu or allergen claims.

findings.summary: Luna reported zero current products even though the accessible restaurant-linked Toast catalog enumerates food, catering, spirits, and specials, and the official HTML menu independently enumerates food and beverage offerings.

The restaurant-issued menu and the current Toast catalog have overlapping but materially different product and service scope; no unified current-product boundary is supported without coordinator/Sol adjudication.

No restaurant-issued allergen matrix, complete ingredients source, or cross-contact policy was found. Visible named ingredients support only narrow positive cues and cannot validate the frozen complete allergen arrays or negatives.

summary: Identity and both Luna surfaces are independently verified. Luna's zero-product catalog is discrepant: accessible Toast contains separately enumerated food, catering, spirits, and specials, while the official menu provides another current but non-identical catalog. The frozen 179 rows were reconciled structurally exactly once, but the source conflict and lack of restaurant-issued allergen/cross-contact evidence require Sol adjudication; no complete allergen arrays, negative claims, or cross-contact conclusions are cleared.
